incidente.resumo: After GitHub migrated its access switches onto new aggregation switches, a bug in the aggregation switches left many MAC addresses unlearned, so traffic was flooded to all ports and saturated the access/aggregation links, causing slow responses and intermittent errors for a whole day; during troubleshooting, an unsupported partial link failure setting disabled redundant links and caused 18 minutes of complete unavailability. The setting was removed, and restarting core processes on the aggregation switches the next morning restored normal traffic and performance.
